# Load libraries and data
```{r}
# Check if any packages need to be downloaded
installed_packages <- c("tidyverse","ggOceanMaps","ggspatial") %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(installed_packages == FALSE)) {
  install.packages(packages[!installed_packages])
}

# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(ggOceanMaps)
library(ggspatial)

# Open the metadata file
metadata <- read.csv("UVP6_Amundsen_2024_leg5_subset.csv")
```


# Sampling distribution
```{r}
# Map the stations using the ggOceanMaps package.
# If you are prompted to download the bathymetry data, enter 1/Yes.

# Prepare the map
basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = TRUE, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-82,-50,68,80), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "#eeeac4",  bathy.style = "poly_grays",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  # Plot the points
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = metadata,
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat,
                                    color = sample_stationid),
                                size = 3,
                                alpha = 1) +
  # Plot the labels
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_text_repel(data = metadata %>% 
                                       distinct(sample_stationid,
                                                .keep_all = TRUE),
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat,
                                    label = sample_stationid,
                                    color = sample_stationid)) +
  # Improve the visuals
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue1", "red", "deeppink1","purple2","black",
                                "orange2", "brown", "forestgreen")) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = c(0.88, 0.75)) +
  guides(color = "none") 

# Output figure
ggsave(filename = "station_map.png",
       width = 6, height = 6, units = "in", bg = "white")
```



# Prepare data
```{r}
load("data/Amund_UVP6_20251031.RData")

theme_set(theme_bw())
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)


metadata <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  filter(sample_cruise == "am_leg5") %>% 
  filter(object_lat > 72.6 & object_lat < 75 & object_lon > -75) %>% 
  # Exclude some replicate casts that were much shallower
  filter(sample_id %notin% c("am_leg5_TCA_T3_07_01","am_leg5_TCA_T3_17_03",
                             "am_leg5_TCA_BB2_03")) %>% 
  mutate(sample_stationid = factor(sample_stationid,
                            levels = c("TCA_T3_08","TCA_T3_09","TCA_T3_10","TCA_BB2",
                                       "TCA_T3_20","TCA_T3_19","TCA_T3_17","TCA_T3_16"))) %>% 
  arrange(sample_stationid) %>% 
  select(-c(volume_m3, object_id, maxDepth))


write.csv(file = "UVP6_Amundsen_2024_leg5_subset.csv",
          metadata)

# Check how many validate Calanus there are per profile
zoop <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% metadata$sample_id)

commun <- zoop %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta, by = "sample_id") %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, taxagroup) %>% 
  summarise(nimgs = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id,
                            levels = unique(metadata$sample_id)))


ggplot(commun, aes(x = sample_id, y = nimgs, fill = taxagroup)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c25) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))


# number of images with lipid sacs:
commun %>% 
  filter(taxagroup == "Copepoda-lipidsac") 

```


# Organize the metadata of the copepod lipid sac images 
N = 286+467 = 753 images for 8 stations
```{r}
# Get column names
df <- read.table("C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/Alix_Amundsen_Leg5/ecotaxa_export__TSV_18084_20251119_0315_side.tsv",
                 sep="\t", header = TRUE, nrows=10)
colnames(df)

df.side <- read_tsv(
  "C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/Alix_Amundsen_Leg5/ecotaxa_export__TSV_18084_20251119_0315_side.tsv", 
  col_select = c(img_file_name, img_rank,
                 object_id, sample_id, sample_cruise, sample_stationid, 
                 object_lon, object_lat, object_date, object_time, object_depth_max,
                 object_annotation_status, object_annotation_category,
                 object_annotation_hierarchy,
                 object_major, object_minor, object_perim., object_feret, object_area, 
                 object_elongation, object_symetriev, object_symetrievc, 
                 object_circ., object_thickr, object_mean, object_median,
                 object_histcum3, object_stddev, object_skew,
                 object_fractal, object_perimferet, object_perimmajor)) %>% 
  filter(img_rank == 100) %>% 
  select(-img_rank)

df.top<- read_tsv(
  "C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/Alix_Amundsen_Leg5/ecotaxa_export__TSV_18084_20251119_0315_top.tsv", 
  col_select = c(img_file_name, img_rank,
                 object_id, sample_id, sample_cruise, sample_stationid, 
                 object_lon, object_lat, object_date, object_time, object_depth_max,
                 object_annotation_status, object_annotation_category,
                 object_annotation_hierarchy,
                 object_major, object_minor, object_perim., object_feret, object_area, 
                 object_elongation, object_symetriev, object_symetrievc, 
                 object_circ., object_thickr, object_mean, object_median,
                 object_histcum3, object_stddev, object_skew,
                 object_fractal, object_perimferet, object_perimmajor)) %>% 
  filter(img_rank == 100) %>% 
  select(-img_rank)

# combine
df.metadata <- bind_rows(df.side, df.top)

rm(df, df.side, df.top)
```
